question: ¿En cuántos ensayos de linfoma que comenzaron en 2020 o más tarde se prueba rituximab?

attempts.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
WHERE s.start_date >= DATE '2020-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.browse_conditions b WHERE b.nct_id = s.nct_id AND b.downcase_mesh_term = 'lymphoma')
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.interventions i WHERE i.nct_id = s.nct_id AND (lower(i.name) LIKE '%rituximab%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%rituxan%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%mabthera%'))
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.intervention_other_names o WHERE o.nct_id = s.nct_id AND (lower(o.name) LIKE '%rituximab%' OR lower(o.name) LIKE '%rituxan%' OR lower(o.name) LIKE '%mabthera%')))
